 NBA Predictions and Trends for Knicks to Bounce Back Against Celtics
 | 
 This article contains references to products from our advertisers and/or partners, and we may receive compensation when you click on links to products and services 
 The New York Knicks lost their opener to the Philadelphia 76ers following the banner ceremony. On Friday night, they’ll look to get their first win of the season against the Boston Celtics. Traders on Kalshi are giving the Celtics an edge at home with a 54% chance to win.
 NBA Player Props to Watch on Kalshi
 Both teams have some new players, so we are going to use those initial games to see what props easily hit and how the best prediction markets have responded.
 Rebounds for Andre Drummond
 Andre Drummond had a great first performance as a member of the Knicks. He had 14 rebounds, 12 points and four assists off the bench. He cleared his total for rebounds in the first half. If you are using the Kalshi promo code , you can take him to have 8+ rebounds at 41%.
 Three-Pointers from Karl-Anthony Towns
 Karl-Anthony Towns went 3-4 from beyond the arc earlier this week, easily surpassing his projection on prediction markets. You’re able to take him to record 2+ threes against the Celtics at 46%.
 Points from Paul George
 Someone must replace Jaylen Brown, and it was Paul George on Tuesday. He dropped 38 points, which set a franchise record for the most points scored in a debut. The Kalshi markets have been on the move, especially since he only averaged around 17 points over the last two seasons in Philadelphia. If you want to take him to have 25+ points, you’ll be looking at a 56% price tag.
 Other Prediction Trends for the Knicks-Celtics
 When looking back at previous matchups between these teams, there are several other trends to note before making your predictions:
 TD Garden Success: New York has won in three of their last five visits to TD Garden across the regular season and playoffs.
 Under Dominance: Four of the last five head-to-head meetings have stayed well below the current 221.5 game total, with three of those games seeing combined totals of 200 points or fewer.
 Star Impact: Jayson Tatum has averaged 28.7 PPG, 9.7 RPG, and 4.6 3PM against New York over 2024–25 and 2025–26, while Jalen Brunson has produced 26.1 PPG and 7.0 APG across 14 matchups, and Karl-Anthony Towns has posted a double-double average of 20.0 PPG and 11.9 RPG.
